name: BENCHMARK_SPEC_V1
sequential_tuning_forbidden: all three prospective datasets are configured in this single freeze; no dataset's outcome may inform another's configuration

protocol.split_rule: date boundaries only; never a random split
protocol.validation: one horizon, used for early stopping, global alpha and gate OOF support

m5.reason: test outcomes already used during development

favorita.reason: test outcomes already used during development

freshretailnet.cleaning: none; sale_amount is already a daily aggregate and is never negative

availability.semantics: number of stockout hours in [6,22); verified against hours_stock_status with a match rate of 1.0000
availability.policy: a day with any stockout hour is marked stockout_mask=1 and its zero is treated as censored, never as observed zero demand

freshretailnet.official_eval_reason: the shipped eval block is 7 days, shorter than the frozen horizon of 28; a temporal holdout is cut from train instead
freshretailnet.split: temporal, taken from the end of the train file

retail_stocks.exclusion_reason: only 129 series carry both the 236-day span and 20 positive train observations the protocol needs; median series life is 14 days. Excluded on structure, before any forecast.
retail_stocks.cleaning: rows with Is Return == 1 are dropped; returns are never demand

uci_online_retail_ii.series_key_rule: StockCode x Country when it yields at least 1000 eligible series, otherwise StockCode; decided on eligibility counts alone
uci_online_retail_ii.cleaning: invoices beginning with C are cancellations and are dropped; non-positive quantities are dropped; neither is counted as demand

availability.policy: days without an invoice line are filled with zero to form the grid, but are reported as unknown rather than observed zero demand

uci_online_retail_ii.split: temporal, taken from the end of the observed span

proposed_method.expert_selection_formula: geometric mean of the convex-oracle ceiling multiplier across datasets, then the worse dataset, then residual correlation, then static loss; pairs whose best static is more than 2% worse than the reference are excluded
proposed_method.gate_cv_scheme: expanding time: a gate is fitted only on folds strictly earlier than the one it is scored on, so fold 0 has no validation row and leave-one-fold-out is not used
proposed_method.mixing_rule: y = (1 - g) * expert_a + g * expert_b, one g per forecast origin
proposed_method.transfer: METHOD TRANSFER, not WEIGHT TRANSFER: weights are refit per dataset

training.checkpoint_rule: validation MSE of the final mean prediction, identical for every DLinear variant
training.hyperparameter_rule: no per-cell tuning; one setting for every cell and every model; TSB alpha/beta chosen on a fixed grid using the validation split only

normalization: per-series mean over the train window (train_scale), train only
global_alpha: fitted on validation/OOF only, frozen before test scoring
gate_fitting: expanding-time OOF inside train; no gate hyperparameter reselection

bootstrap.note: time rows are never resampled as if independent

hypotheses.RQ1: the proposed adaptive gate beats the best single expert and the best static mixture on unseen datasets
hypotheses.RQ2: the diverse pair raises the convex-oracle ceiling over the reference pair
hypotheses.RQ3: the gate recovers part of that raised ceiling
hypotheses.RQ4: results differ between datasets with and without availability signal
hypotheses.RQ5: where the method sits against classical intermittent baselines

exclusion_criteria: a dataset is excluded only on structural grounds decided before scoring; never because its result is unfavourable
failure_handling: a method that fails on a dataset is reported as failed, with the reason, and is not removed from the table
